$comment: The known, deliberate differences between Python's Settings (deepeval/config/settings.py)
`npm run check:env-parity` recomputes the difference and fails when it stops matching this file,
so drifting apart is a CI failure rather than something discovered months later.
Adding a variable to one SDK means either adding it to the other or recording the reason here.

blockedOnSubsystem.$comment: Would be ported, but the feature they configure does not exist in TS yet.

lmStudioAndVllm.$comment: Both are OpenAI-compatible servers already reachable through LOCAL_MODEL_BASE_URL. Kept listed so the decision is explicit rather than an oversight.

remoteImageFetching.$comment: TS never downloads remote images: mllm-image.ts leaves http(s) URLs unfetched and passes them straight to the provider, so there is nothing to time out.

voiceSimulation.$comment: Voice mode is Python-only: there is no VoiceConfig, connector, or TTS/STT model in typescript/src, so there is no audio for TS to write anywhere.

neverPorting.$comment: Will not be ported. Each needs a reason, not just a listing.

retryPolicy.$comment: Python's knobs configure a retry layer wrapping LLM provider calls, built on tenacity plus 1000+ lines of per-provider exception taxonomy. TS delegates to each provider SDK's own retry (openai and @anthropic-ai/sdk default to 2), which is what Python does when a provider is listed in DEEPEVAL_SDK_RETRY_PROVIDERS. Adding a deepeval-level retry without also zeroing the SDK's would nest the two layers and multiply the attempt count.

pythonRuntimeSpecific.$comment: Configure CPython, CUDA, or HuggingFace behavior that has no Node equivalent.

noFeatureToOptOutOf.$comment: cli/version.ts only reads package.json, so there is no update check to suppress. Revisit if TS gains one.

typescriptOnly.$comment: Accepted by TS with no Python counterpart.

reasons.GEMINI_API_KEY: Accepted as an alias of GOOGLE_API_KEY because the Google SDKs read both.
reasons.MOONSHOT_BASE_URL: Python hardcodes Moonshot's base URL; TS lets it be overridden.

outsideBothSchemas.$comment: Read directly from process.env rather than declared as settings, so they are invisible to `deepeval settings` and `deepeval diagnose` by design. Internal, run-scoped plumbing set by the CLI for its own workers, not intended for users.
